Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

relax — to rest and feel calm. Example: I relax at the weekend.
rest — to stop working and relax. Example: You need to rest.
lazy — not wanting to work. Example: He is lazy on Sunday mornings.
busy — having a lot to do. Example: I am busy this week.
weekend — Saturday and Sunday. Example: My weekend is quiet.
hobby — an activity you enjoy in free time. Example: My hobby is reading.
nap — a short sleep in the day. Example: I sometimes have a nap.
quiet — with little noise. Example: The weekend is quiet.
enjoy — to like doing something. Example: I enjoy doing nothing.
free time — time when you are not working. Example: What do you do in your free time?
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I usually relax at the weekend.
• I sometimes have a nap.
• I never work on Sunday.
• I enjoy doing nothing.
• What do you do in your free time?

Use the present simple for routines, with adverbs of frequency before the main verb: I usually relax at the weekend. She never has a nap.
